review.tagline: LangGraph multi-agent framework simulating a trading firm to analyze tickers
review.summary: TradingAgents runs a team of LLM agents (fundamentals, sentiment, news and technical analysts, bull and bear researchers, trader, risk team, portfolio manager) that debate and produce a trading decision for a ticker and date. It is built on LangGraph, with a CLI and a Python API, and works with many hosted providers plus Ollama and OpenAI-compatible servers. The README states it is for research, not financial advice.
review.audience: Researchers and developers experimenting with LLM agents for market analysis
strengths: Many LLM providers, plus Ollama and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint such as vLLM or llama.cpp
Quick and deep model tiers, each configurable with its own provider
Point-in-time data for backtests, with SEC EDGAR statements as originally filed
Interactive CLI, flag-driven non-interactive runs, and a Python API
weaknesses: Approved orders go only to a simulated exchange; no live broker execution described
Results vary with model, temperature and data quality; README says research use only
Past-dated runs withhold Yahoo fundamentals and insider trades for non-SEC companies
Needs a provider API key; import paths changed in v0.5.1
needs: Needs Python 3.11+, LangGraph, LLM provider API key or Ollama, Yahoo Finance, SEC EDGAR, Alpha Vantage (optional), FRED (optional)
Models: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, xAI, DeepSeek
